S.FORM: sabato kakilimaan i kaliking sohong sapicumud i ci widiyan, sabawcacay ku bangu a dadan, namakaamis tayda i timus ikawanan nu dadan, iayaw nu ciwidiyan a cacudadan, idaw kuni patideng tu salisinan sabatu sapikining tu pituway a tumuk. nilacul 起源 Baetu u kamu nu Sakizaya, u sasalisin a buyu i sauwad nu sakidaya sabatu han, u imi sa, i sasa nu sauwac tanu batu sa. Sabatu hananay u tatabakiya a baetu masilat, yasasalisinan sabatu u sasalisidan nu ci winiyan a niyadu, u sakidaya a tamdaw masikad tu baetu, u baetu ani'tu patidaku, ina sasalisinan hanu baetuen misilad, u sangaw nu niyadu'ay atu di'tu, patineng tuni simsiman. 啟用儀式 Sabatu u salisinan nay i tusaay a malbud walu a mihcaan mahamin sangaan, sakidaya i tusa a malbud siway a mihcaan cacay a mulad samaw tu pitu a demiad, misalisin na panganga tusa tu amihcaan atu napatideng tu sasalisinan, uyda a demiad binawlan mipacuk tu tusay a pabu, pasimel tu titi, ina sasalisidan patideng hidan tunu cacay a malbud walu a lasubu pitu a bataan walu a mihcaan nu takumuwan a kawaw(kaliyawan a kawaw) u sakidaya masibek, papina-ay mueneng i kilay a mukelal nu tipan satimulan a tudi, ci widiyan a binawlan maluyaluy milakuud tu sauwad nu ci kasuwan atu talawadaw, miduduc tu sadipasan maytimulan mulaliw, makatukuh satu i ciwidiyan. ci widiyan a niyadu, a mikining tu papituway a tumuk, patideng satu tu baetu a paya atu sasalisidan. 八顆巨石 Sabatu a sasalisidan walu ku ni patideng tu tatabakiyay a matu, mabali', malamec, lecuhan, matuduh, kasikad, malaluk, madimel, kadihiyi, ina sapitulun nama kayda i buyuay tuluway a kalimucu nu pildac ani pasubana.
S.PHON: sabato kaki[r|ɾ]imaan i ka[r|ɾ]ikiŋ soħoŋ sapiʦumud i ʦi widijan sabawʦaʦaj ku baŋu a dadan namakaamis tajda i timus ikawanan nu dadan iajaw nu ʦiwidijan a ʦaʦudadan idaw kuni patidəŋ tu sa[r|ɾ]isinan sabatu sapikiniŋ tu pituwaj a tumuk ni[r|ɾ]aʦu[r|ɾ] ** baətu u kamu nu sakizaja u sasa[r|ɾ]isin a buju i sauwad nu sakidaja sabatu ħan u imi sa i sasa nu sauwaʦ tanu batu sa sabatu ħananaj u tatabakija a baətu masi[r|ɾ]at jasasa[r|ɾ]isinan sabatu u sasa[r|ɾ]isidan nu ʦi winijan a nijadu u sakidaja a tamdaw masikad tu baətu u baətu ani[ʔ|ʡ]tu patidaku ina sasa[r|ɾ]isinan ħanu baətuən misi[r|ɾ]ad u saŋaw nu nijadu[ʔ|ʡ]aj atu di[ʔ|ʡ]tu patinəŋ tuni simsiman **** sabatu u sa[r|ɾ]isinan naj i tusaaj a ma[r|ɾ]bud wa[r|ɾ]u a miħʦaan maħamin saŋaan sakidaja i tusa a ma[r|ɾ]bud siwaj a miħʦaan ʦaʦaj a mu[r|ɾ]ad samaw tu pitu a dəmiad misa[r|ɾ]isin na paŋaŋa tusa tu amiħʦaan atu napatidəŋ tu sasa[r|ɾ]isinan ujda a dəmiad binaw[r|ɾ]an mipaʦuk tu tusaj a pabu pasimə[r|ɾ] tu titi ina sasa[r|ɾ]isidan patidəŋ ħidan tunu ʦaʦaj a ma[r|ɾ]bud wa[r|ɾ]u a [r|ɾ]asubu pitu a bataan wa[r|ɾ]u a miħʦaan nu takumuwan a kawawka[r|ɾ]ijawan a kawaw u sakidaja masibək papinaaj muənəŋ i ki[r|ɾ]aj a mukə[r|ɾ]a[r|ɾ] nu tipan satimu[r|ɾ]an a tudi ʦi widijan a binaw[r|ɾ]an ma[r|ɾ]uja[r|ɾ]uj mi[r|ɾ]akuud tu sauwad nu ʦi kasuwan atu ta[r|ɾ]awadaw miduduʦ tu sadipasan majtimu[r|ɾ]an mu[r|ɾ]a[r|ɾ]iw makatukuħ satu i ʦiwidijan ʦi widijan a nijadu a mikiniŋ tu papituwaj a tumuk patidəŋ satu tu baətu a paja atu sasa[r|ɾ]isidan **** sabatu a sasa[r|ɾ]isidan wa[r|ɾ]u ku ni patidəŋ tu tatabakijaj a matu maba[r|ɾ]i[ʔ|ʡ] ma[r|ɾ]aməʦ [r|ɾ]əʦuħan matuduħ kasikad ma[r|ɾ]a[r|ɾ]uk madimə[r|ɾ] kadiħiji ina sapitu[r|ɾ]un nama kajda i bujuaj tu[r|ɾ]uwaj a ka[r|ɾ]imuʦu nu pi[r|ɾ]daʦ ani pasubana
